zh-CN.title: 《般若波罗蜜多心经》
zh-CN.subtitle: 般若类佛教经典
zh-CN.shortSummary: 《心经》以高度凝练的形式呈现般若思想，是汉传佛教中传播最广的经典之一。
curatorialDescription: 本馆把《心经》的原文、译本、传播和后世诵读分开记录，避免把流行名句当成脱离文本版本的格言。
zh-CN.researchNote: 文本的具体译者、版本和异文将在 passage 审校批次中逐项补齐。

en.title: Heart Sutra
en.subtitle: A Buddhist Prajñāpāramitā scripture
en.shortSummary: The Heart Sutra presents Prajñāpāramitā thought in a highly condensed form and became one of the most widely circulated texts in Chinese Buddhism.
curatorialDescription: The museum records the Heart Sutra's text, versions, transmission and later recitation separately instead of treating a popular line as a context-free maxim.
en.researchNote: Specific translators, editions and variant readings will be verified passage by passage in the next editorial batch.
